newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers depressed amid ample supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers depressed amid ample supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunker levels on Wednesday dipped on poor demand, traders said.
They expected that the market to remain depressed in the near term, citing unabsorbed supplies in the cargo market.
"The markets in Singapore and Europe are long," said one major.

Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $95-$97 per tonne with one to two independents offering as low as $93 per tonne. Quotes on Tuesday were at around $96-$99. Bunker 180-cst was quoted around $100-$102, traders said.
